title: API database password typo
alert: The API health check fails and product pages return 500 errors; the web frontend still loads but shows no products.

truth.root_cause: api 2.3.2 was deployed with a typo in the DATABASE_PASSWORD environment variable, so the application cannot authenticate to PostgreSQL.
truth.fix: Roll back api to 2.3.1, then verify the health endpoint and product pages work again.
